description: Joint Research Centre: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Simulated world-city public transport networks; Public transport research and innovation in Europe - list of projects; UDP - Total GDP by metro regions, 2000 - 2060 (JRC LUISA Reference Sce; UDP - Total employment by metro regions, 2000 - 2060 (JRC LUISA Refere. Formats seen: CSV, ZIP, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
